paper_title: Upper Limit on the QCD Axion Mass from Isolated Neutron Star Cooling
coupling_convention: dimensionless g_ann (axion-neutron coupling g_aNN = C_N m_N / f_a)
notes: Paper constrains QCD axion via isolated neutron star (Magnificent Seven + PSR J0659) cooling. Primary result: m_a <~ 16 meV (95% CL) for KSVZ axion; phenomenological limits |g_ann| < 1.3e-9 and |g_app| < 1.5e-9 at 95% CL. Reported here is the mass-independent axion-neutron coupling bound (valid for axion masses well below NS core temperature; no explicit mass range stated, hence mass=0 sentinel). The paper also excludes a 2D region in the (g_ann, g_app) plane (Fig. S5, not numerically extractable) and provides DFSZ limits vs tan(beta). This is an astrophysical cooling bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumed.
